name: theatre-marquee-bulbs
title: Theatre Marquee Bulbs
description: A theatre sign where the border is a string of chasing light bulbs (CSS radial dots animating in sequence) around the lettering — the chase runs the perimeter while the text stays still, unlike every other marquee.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Retro
Macrostructure: Mosaic
Density: Dense
Shape: Rounded
Motion: Kinetic
Typography: Serif Display
Color: Neon On Dark

## Rules

- Ambient Loop: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
